session_name.label: Chat name
session_name.hint: Display name for this chat session.

preset_combo.label: Preset & template
preset_combo.hint: Cycle presets, YAML templates, and presentation styles.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Enter/Space: pick model. Click (?): Wuji catalog details.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: Sampling temperature; lower is more deterministic.

context_window.label: Context window
context_window.hint: Enter: type token limit. <-/->: adjust in steps.

context_window_fixed.label: Context window
context_window_fixed.hint: Context window is fixed by the model catalog.

max_steps.label: Max steps
max_steps.hint: Maximum autonomous tool-call steps per request.

decisions_enabled.label: Decisions
decisions_enabled.hint: Allow the agent to record project decisions.

memory_enabled.label: Memory
memory_enabled.hint: Enable long-term memory for this chat.

system_prompt_extra.label: System prompt extra
system_prompt_extra.hint: Extra system instructions appended for this chat.

stt_enabled.label: Voice input enabled
stt_enabled.hint: Microphone button in the chat input (|O|).

stt_driver.label: STT driver
stt_driver.hint: Wuji driver for wuji text --audio (e.g. llama). Saves capability_drivers.text on apply.

stt_model.label: STT model
stt_model.hint: Model id passed to the STT driver (empty = driver default).

stt_language.label: Transcription language
stt_language.hint: Hint language for transcription; {auto_lang} uses automatic detection.

stt_quality.label: Transcription quality
stt_quality.hint: Speed vs accuracy preset for transcription (driver-dependent).

stt_trim_silence.label: Trim silence
stt_trim_silence.hint: Drop leading/trailing silence from recorded audio before STT.

stt_silence_level.label: Silence level
stt_silence_level.hint: Volume threshold for silence detection when trim is on.

stt_capture_device.label: Capture device
stt_capture_device.hint: Audio input device name or path (empty = system default).

ui_theme.label: Color theme
ui_theme.hint: Enter: fuzzy search themes. <-/->: cycle. User themes: ~/.config/taiji/themes/

ui_corners.label: Corner style
ui_corners.hint: Square or rounded frame, or flat fill without an outer border.

ui_locale.label: Interface language
ui_locale.hint: Language for settings labels and common UI text.

tool_call_density.label: Tool activity
tool_call_density.hint: How tool steps appear in the chat: inline (write rows + diffs), subtree, clustered summary, or ignore (file change diffs only, no tool rows).

file_diff_layout.label: File diff layout
file_diff_layout.hint: Show file changes stacked (unified) or side by side (original vs modified).

activity_spacing_lines.label: Activity spacing
activity_spacing_lines.hint: Blank lines between tool steps, writes, edits, and diff cards in a turn.

message_spacing_lines.label: Message spacing
message_spacing_lines.hint: Blank lines between your messages and assistant replies, and between turns.

activity_show_pipeline_title.label: Activity model row
activity_show_pipeline_title.hint: Show the Taiji (model) header line above tool steps in the activity tree.

tool_expand_sections.label: Tool expand content
tool_expand_sections.hint: What to show when you expand a tool step (parameters, result, both, or nothing).

tool_expand_args_format.label: Tool parameter format
tool_expand_args_format.hint: How expanded tool arguments are formatted.

tool_expand_result_format.label: Tool result format
tool_expand_result_format.hint: How expanded tool output is formatted (JSON pretty-prints when the output is valid JSON).

turn_metrics_preset.label: Turn metrics
turn_metrics_preset.hint: Verbosity of per-turn metrics in the chat log.

turn_metrics_show_actions.label: Turn actions
turn_metrics_show_actions.hint: Show redo/copy controls under finished turns.

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.hint: How assistant messages are rendered in this chat.

user_message_align.label: Alignment
user_message_align.hint: Horizontal placement; {auto} follows the role (you: right, assistant: left).

user_message_max_width_pct.label: Max width
user_message_max_width_pct.hint: <-/-> or click the bar to set max bubble width (40–100%).

user_message_fill_background.label: Fill background
user_message_fill_background.hint: {on}: solid fill behind your message frame (border included). {off}: outline only on the chat background.

assistant_message_align.label: Alignment
assistant_message_align.hint: Horizontal placement; {auto} follows the role (you: right, assistant: left).

assistant_message_max_width_pct.label: Max width
assistant_message_max_width_pct.hint: <-/-> or click the bar to set max bubble width (40–100%).

assistant_message_fill_background.label: Fill background
assistant_message_fill_background.hint: {on}: solid fill behind your message frame (border included). {off}: outline only on the chat background.

message_timestamps.label: Timestamps
message_timestamps.hint: Show send time on your message bubbles.

sticky_user_message.label: Sticky prompt
sticky_user_message.hint: Pin the top of your last scrolled prompt while reading long replies.

auto_compact_context_pct.label: Auto-compact
auto_compact_context_pct.hint: When context fills this % of the window, summarize older turns automatically.

chat_width.label: Chat width
chat_width.hint: Maximum width of the chat column (terminal cells).

code_block_wrap.label: Code wrap
code_block_wrap.hint: Wrap long lines inside fenced code blocks.

tool_labels_locale.label: Tool labels
tool_labels_locale.hint: Language for tool status labels in the UI.

reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion
reduce_motion.hint: Minimize interface motion (reserved for future animations).

key_open_theme_picker.label: Theme picker shortcut
key_open_theme_picker.hint: Global shortcut to open the color theme picker (e.g. Ctrl+T).

mcp_toggle.hint: Space: enable server for this chat. Enter: expand or collapse tools.

mcp_tool_toggle.hint: Space: allow or block this tool for the chat.

skill_toggle.hint: Restrict skills to an allowlist, or allow all.

pack_toggle.hint: Enable or disable context packs for this chat (empty allowlist = all packs).
